title: Microtek invests over ₹400 crore to accelerate solar business growth
description:
Microtek has announced an investment of over Rs 400 crore to accelerate the growth of its solar business.
As part of its expansion plans, Microtek has invested over Rs 400 crore and is setting up a new solar panel manufacturing plant in Jaipur, which is expected to become operational by November 2026, the company said at the renewable energy expo 2026 concluded on Saturday.
Led by its 'Har Ghar Bijli Ghar' vision, the company will introduce its new Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), highlighting its focus on making reliable energy solutions accessible to households and businesses, the company said in a statement issued on Sunday.
With nearly four decades of power management experience, Microtek's portfolio spans four pillars: power generation, distribution, conditioning and storage.
At the expo, the company showcased its home inverters, UPS systems, batteries, electrical wires, solar panels, solar inverters and lithium batteries.
